about: The M2 contracts, frozen as historical records. Each was scored by the harness commit it names, over the frozen pull whose manifest SHA-256 it names, and that pull is gone, so none can be re-scored. The contract-currency gate (test_contracts_current.py) exempts exactly these paths, named one by one; it exempts nothing by pattern and no current contract. Every other contract is current: it is scored again whenever the scorer changes (docs/reproducing.md).
